# eMedia

> eMedia is Utah Education Network's comprehensive digital library and OER platform for discovering, sharing, and creating open educational resources with curriculum collaboration tools.

eMedia serves educators across Utah and beyond by providing access to curated open educational resources, subject-specific hubs (including STEM, AI, and civics), and tools for content creation and lesson planning. The platform integrates institutional authentication, supports multiple learning management systems via LTI, and emphasizes accessibility standards.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Utah Education Network (UEN)
- Open Author
- OER Commons

## Browse & Discover OER

- [eMedia Homepage](https://emedia.uen.org): eMedia homepage: UEN's digital library for OER, lesson planning, and educator collaboration
- [Browse OER Materials](https://emedia.uen.org/oer): Browse and discover open educational resources by subject, material type, and course
- [Curated Collections](https://emedia.uen.org/curated-collections): Curated collections of educational resources including textbooks and media libraries
- [Browse Providers](https://emedia.uen.org/oer/providers): Directory of OER providers including AIR, Annenberg, and other content organizations

## Educational Hubs & Networks

- [Network Hubs Directory](https://emedia.uen.org/hubs): Directory of educational hubs covering STEM, AI, adult education, and specialized topics
- [Computer Science & STEM Hub](https://emedia.uen.org/hubs/CS): Computer Science and STEM educational hub with robotics and curriculum resources
- [Artificial Intelligence Hub](https://emedia.uen.org/hubs/ai): AI education hub with curriculum integration resources and USBE AI Framework materials
- [America250 Utah Hub](https://emedia.uen.org/hubs/america250): Educational hub for U.S. history, civics, and America250 anniversary classroom activities

## Community Groups & Collaboration

- [Community Groups Directory](https://emedia.uen.org/groups): Directory of community groups including Utah OER Collective and CS4Utah networks
- [USLA Group Resources](https://emedia.uen.org/groups/usla/54): USLA group resources featuring Caldecott Medal literature and children's picture books
- [UCET Group Resources](https://emedia.uen.org/groups/ucet/114): UCET group resources for personalized learning and classroom technology integration

## Content Creation & Authoring

- [Authoring Overview](https://emedia.uen.org/authoring-overview): Guide to Open Author content creation tool with accessibility standards and cloud integration

## Access & Authentication

- [Login & Account Creation](https://emedia.uen.org/courses/add): eMedia login page with institutional SAML authentication and account creation
- [SAML Single Sign-On](https://emedia.uen.org/saml-login): SAML single sign-on login page for institutional access to eMedia platform

## Support & Documentation

- [Help Center](https://emedia.uen.org/help-center): Help center with guides for search, content creation, LTI integration, and accessibility
- [About eMedia](https://emedia.uen.org/about): About eMedia: Utah Education Network's OER platform for digital learning and content creation
